text: Shipped 0.1 after ~29 s of game-time pushing (5 s W + 24 s Shift+W). First message explained the loop clearly; '33 m uphill' gave a clear goal.

After pushing from the uphill side for 1.5 s on the 0.2 terrace (as the hint 'From up here, walking into it rolls it back (on level ground)' suggests), HUD says 'The boulder is rolling back down!' in red. Did it go over the terrace edge? Docs say it stops at the edge.

Patching works once the crosshair is on the module: hold E ~4 s and search went 77% -> 100%, 'No open issues. It will not last.' Finding the failing module took several minutes though: it was underneath the boulder (only a faint purple floating 'search' label from a distance).

Held Shift+W for 15 s from what looked (in V third-person view) like right behind the boulder; walked straight past it and ended 49 m above it. Passing beside the boulder gives no feedback; the push contact is narrow.

Second time: lined up with the boulder filling the right 2/3 of the view (m4.png), held Shift+W 12 s; boulder moved only 3 m (33->30 m) and Sisyphus walked on past it, ending 32 m above. Holding W does not keep him on the boulder: it slides off to the side with no warning.

Shipped 0.3 and patched core right after. Pushing worked well this time once the boulder was centred in the third-person (V) view; the patch prompt and the floating module labels on the boulder are clear when close.
The floating module label ('billing') is drawn underneath the crosshair prompt text and becomes unreadable when it sits in the lower middle of the screen (here behind 'F to refactor').
Let router decay to 0%: HUD turns red, 'OUTAGE: users are leaving' (400 -> 373), router DOWN, and uploads 'uses router, down' rots at -45%/min. Clear, well-signposted consequence.
Reached the summit: '1.0 shipped, at the summit. Look down at the town.' about 34 min wall-clock into the session (with two wasted detours). Very satisfying beat.

After the summit the boulder rolls away ('It rolls. Follow it down. The boulder: 80 m to your left'), but the outage keeps draining users (368 -> 314) and modules keep rotting while the player can do nothing. Also parser's issue reads 'flaky test +' with an unexplained '+'.
